mandatoryCriteria: Owner timezone updates accept only zones supported by the actual Intl calendar runtime; invalid/time-like/unknown input gives controlled422 and no row/version mutation.
An invalid legacy persisted timezone must fail with a safe configuration error rather than silently change calendar semantics to UTC; deployed preflight detects such values before rollout.
Nonowners remain unable to update workspace preferences; expectedVersion protects concurrent edits and valid timezone changes preserve card date-only values.
MyTasks returns server workspace asOfDate/timezone for invited users as well as owner, and changed timezone invalidates old continuation context.
Shared input validation is used by mounted route; actual Worker/Node runtime checks and final independent review remain required.
